purpose: An advocate's investigation and opinion on ownership and title to identified immovable property.
likely_user_role: property purchaser, lender, developer, or due-diligence reviewer
stronger_party: not applicable; this is a legal opinion, not a negotiated agreement
false_positive_guardrails: Referenced deeds, loans and permissions are title-chain evidence, not separate agreements to score.
Do not apply payment, termination or missing-contract-clause rules to a title report.
A historical mortgage is not automatically a current charge; verify its discharge separately.
